purpose: Narrow candidate capability paths for Relay/QA criterion 5 without requesting or exposing founder keys/seeds and without spending.
selection_requirements: x402-compatible payment authorization for Base USDC
private key/seed never enters model context, repository, prompts, logs, Drive or Airtable
signing policy enforced outside the model/agent process
per-transaction cap enforceable at or below founder A$25 equivalent
daily/session cumulative cap enforceable at or below founder A$40 equivalent
provider/recipient allowlisting or an equivalent deterministic recipient policy
agent cannot raise its own limits, add funds, or make arbitrary transfers
audit-visible payment attempts/receipts and a kill/revoke mechanism
supports zero-spend conformance testing before funding

public_candidate_observations.candidate: Coinbase/CDP managed x402 client / agentic wallet boundary
observed_public_capabilities: public examples describe server-side spend controls including maxAmountPerPayment and maxCumulativeSpend
public examples show allowedNetworks including Base eip155:8453
x402 payment client support is publicly documented
unverified_for_james: whether the connected capability available to this runtime can deny arbitrary transfers/add-funds
recipient/provider allowlist enforcement in the exact connected product surface
whether zero-spend conformance evidence can be exported without exposing credentials

observed_public_capabilities: public documentation claims policy-bound wallets with per-call/per-hour/per-day caps
public documentation claims counterparty allowlists and chain pinning
public documentation claims x402 automatic 402 retry and structured receipts
public documentation describes hardware-backed/MPC-compatible signer options
unverified_for_james: independent operational maturity and custody/security assurance
whether agent authority excludes add-funds/arbitrary-transfer/limit changes in the exact deployment
whether Base-only native-USDC can be made immutable to the agent

qa_rule: Public product claims and configuration declarations are discovery evidence only. Criterion 5 remains FAIL until James has a connected purpose-limited capability and records observed zero-spend conformance results for every required denial/enforcement behavior.
next_action: Prefer a managed/MPC/TEE boundary that exposes only a purpose-specific x402 purchase operation to James. Once connected by an operator outside model-visible surfaces, run the zero-spend conformance matrix before any funding or paid benchmark.
truthfulness: This artifact is a capability shortlist based on public documentation. It is not evidence that either wallet is connected, funded, safe for James, or Relay/QA-approved.
